instruction: Like all the songs from the artists I follow on Spotify.
notes: The actual number of followed artists and their songs is only discovered at runtime, so the model uses placeholders: two followed artists with two songs each (artist-1/artist-2, song-i-j). show_following_artists is modeled as a single listing action that makes the followed artists' ids known (following-artists-known); show_artist then reveals each artist's name (used as the search query), search_songs with query+artist_id reveals that artist's songs (songs-searched), and like_song requires the song to be from a searched followed artist and not already liked. Because the goal (every song of every followed artist liked) is task-specific and PDDL has no quantified preconditions under the allowed requirements, the target songs are declared as domain constants so supervisor-complete-task can list (liked ...) for each of them as its precondition; they are not redeclared in the problem objects. The static facts (followed ?ar), (artist-name ?ar ?q), (song-by ?s ?ar) describe the world structure, not agent knowledge; knowledge is tracked by following-artists-known, artist-details-known and songs-searched. At runtime the agent should paginate show_following_artists and search_songs and skip songs that are already liked. complete_task is called without an answer.
